name: Advanced Data Structure and Algorithms Lab
description: Basics of algorithm analysis. Elementary data structures. Hashing, analysis of collision resolution techniques. Priority queues. Dynamic programming: rod cutting problem, matrix multiplication, longest common sequence, optimal binary search tree. Greedy algorithms: Huffman coding, activity selection problem, knapsack problem. Sparse matrices manipulation. String matching, matching DNA sequences. Cryptography. System security. Network security.
